name: 81-font-variant-caps
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 18px; color: #111; background: #fff; } p { margin: 8px 0; line-height: 1.6; } .small { font-variant-caps: small-caps; } .all { font-variant-caps: all-small-caps; } .reset { font-variant-caps: small-caps; } .reset span { font-variant-caps: normal; } .inline .small { font-size: 22px; }
html:
Small-caps Abc DEF 中文保持

All-small-caps Abc DEF 中文保持

Small-caps normal 覆盖 Abc 中文

行内字号 Abc 22px 与 Def 18px 对照
